optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Administer Aid|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can expend a superiority die to tend to a creature you can touch. The creature regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the number rolled + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Administer Aid|sw5e-phb} (Greater)
entries: You can use your {@optfeature Administer Aid|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} as an action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, or {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Administer Aid|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: You can use your {@optfeature Administer Aid|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} as an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Adrenaline Hit|sw5e-phb}
entries: You can use an action and expend one superiority die to inject a creature with regenerative medication that temporarily enhances their agility. When you do so, a creature you can touch regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the superiority die roll. Additionally, until the start of your next turn, when that creature would take damage, the amount is reduced by an amount equal to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Assist|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Automatic Startup Sequence|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}

When a creature makes a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you may expend a superiority die, subtracting the number rolled from their total.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Body Over Bother|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you are forced to make an Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can expend a superiority die to change the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} ability to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Call the Guards|sw5e-phb}
entries: When a creature makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a superiority die and command a willing ally within 5 feet of that creature to use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to intercede. The creature is then forced to make an attack on the ally instead. If the attack misses, the ally can immediately make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against that creature as a part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. Roll the superiority die, and add the result to the ally's {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Call to Arms|sw5e-phb}
entries: If you are surprised at the start of combat and aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb}, you can expend one superiority die to act normally.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Call to Arms|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: When you use your {@optfeature Call to Arms|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you can roll the superiority die and extend the benefits of the {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} to a number of allies up to the result of the roll, provided those allies can see or hear you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Calling Card|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can expend a superiority die to throw a {@spell Sonic Charge|sw5e-phb|sonic charge} at a target you can see within 30 feet. When you do so, the target and each creature of your choice within 5 feet of it must make Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, taking sonic damage on a failure. The sonic damage equals the number rolled on the superiority die.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn, you can expend one superiority die to spur your allies to move. Until the start of your next turn, creatures you choose within 10 feet of you who can see or hear you can move an additional distance equal to 5 times the superiority die rolled on their turn and ignore unenhanced {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Charging Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: If you move at least 10 feet towards your target before successfully hitting them with a melee attack, you may expend a superiority die, causing the target to take additional damage equal to the result, and forcing it to make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save the creature is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Charming Presence|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check and expend one superiority die to attempt to charm a humanoid creature who can see or hear you within 60 feet. Add the superiority die to the roll. The target makes a contested Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Commander's Strike|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn, you can forgo one of your attacks and use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do so, choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you and expend one superiority die. That creature can immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, adding the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Commander's Strike|sw5e-phb} (Greater)
entries: When you use the {@optfeature Commander's Strike|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you can choose to forgo an attack or use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, rather than both. All the other rules of {@optfeature Commander's Strike|sw5e-phb} still apply to you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Commander's Strike|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: When you use the {@optfeature Commander's Strike|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you no longer have to forgo an attack as a part of that {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}. All the other rules of {@optfeature Commander's Strike|sw5e-phb} still apply to you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Conceal|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Crippling Blow|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to cripple the creature. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll and the creature's gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of their next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Deceive|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Disarming Blow|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to disarm the target, forcing it to drop one item of your choice that it's holding. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it drops the object you choose. If you have a free hand and are within 5 feet of the creature, you can catch the item. Otherwise, the object lands at the creature's feet.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Distracting Blow|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to distract the creature, giving your allies an opening. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll. The next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the target by an attacker other than you has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Effective Flanking|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you choose a target within 30 feet that you can see to make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, roll a superiority die; the result is added to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the creature before the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Effective Flanking|sw5e-phb} (Greater)
entries: When you use the {@optfeature Effective Flanking|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you add your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier to both the attack and damage roll for the first attack against the creature before the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Effective Flanking|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: When you use the {@optfeature Effective Flanking|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you add the result of the superiority die to both the attack and damage roll for the first attack against the creature before the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Empathize|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Encouraging Pace|sw5e-phb}
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to expend and roll a superiority die. When you do so, a number of friendly creatures equal to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier can immediately use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move a number of feet equal to 5 times the number rolled on the superiority die.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Encouraging Speech|sw5e-phb}
entries: You can expend a superiority die to give an {@optfeature Encouraging Speech|sw5e-phb|encouraging speech}, spending the next minute rallying your allies. You grant two allies temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled on the superiority die + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.
This increases to three allies at 5th level, four allies at 9th level, five allies at 13th level, and six allies at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Enhancement Injection|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can expend one superiority die to inject a creature you can touch with enhancements, granting them temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the superiority die roll + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier, which last for 1 minute. Additionally, when the target makes a Strength or Constitution check or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} while it has these temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it gains a bonus equal to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Evasive Footwork|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you move, you can expend one superiority die, rolling the die and adding the number rolled to your AC until you stop moving.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Exploit Weakness|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend a superiority die and deal additional true damage equal to the number rolled.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Fast Access Programs|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}

When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-level or higher that has a casting time of 1 action, you can expend a superiority die to change the casting time to 1 {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} for this casting.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Feinting Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: You can expend one superiority die and use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of you as your target. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against that creature this turn. If that attack hits, add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Firewall|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}

When you or an ally you can see within 60 feet make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend a superiority die, adding the number rolled to the result of that {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

optionalfeature.name: Flex
entries: When you make an {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Flourish|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an Sleight of Hand check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Force Resonance|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

Immediately after you deal damage to a target with a force attack, you can expend a superiority die and target a second creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature. Roll the die, and the second creature takes force damage equal to the roll + your {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Fortune and Glory|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

When you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a target within 30 feet, you can instead manipulate the Force to expend a superiority die and make a Sleight of Hand check using your universal {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} to plant something on the target, {@optfeature Conceal|sw5e-phb|conceal} an object on the target, lift the target's purse, or take something from its pocket. Roll the superiority die, and add the result to the check.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Goading Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on all {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Hacked Communications|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you may expend a superiority die, and choose any number of creatures that you can see within 60 feet of you that have commlinks, headcomms, or other such communications devices. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take sonic damage equal to the number rolled on the dice + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier (minimum of one). Additionally, on a failed save, their communication devices are disabled until rebooted.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Handle Animal|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Heads Up|sw5e-phb}
entries: When a friendly creature who can see or hear you makes a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a superiority die, adding the number rolled to the result of the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Incite|sw5e-phb}
entries: On your turn, you can use an action and expend one superiority die to bolster the resolve of one of an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. The ally can add your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier to every damage roll they make until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Inner Strength|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can expend and roll one superiority die, gaining temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the result of the roll + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Intimidating Presence|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) check and expend one superiority die to attempt to frighten a humanoid creature who can see or hear you within 60 feet. Add the superiority die to the roll. The target makes a contested Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. If your check succeeds, the target is {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} of you until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Investigate|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Lunging Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} on your turn, you can expend one superiority die to increase your reach for that attack by 5 feet. If you hit, you add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Maneuvering Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} one of your comrades into a more advantageous position. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and you choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you.

That creature can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from the target of your attack.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Menacing Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to frighten the target. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it is {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} of you until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Mind Over Matter|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you are forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can expend a superiority die to change the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} ability to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Naturalize|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Neuroblock|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can expend a superiority die and add it to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. On a hit, the creature's next attack has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} and it cannot regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature No Escape|sw5e-phb}
entries: Whenever you or an ally you can see makes an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, you can expend a superiority die. If the attack hits, roll the superiority die and add the result to the damage roll. Additionally, the affected creature gains 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels until the start of its next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature One Step Ahead|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and you are not surprised, you can expend a superiority die and add the number rolled to your {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} check.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature One With Shadows|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you are in an area of dim light or {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, you can use your action and expend one superiority die to become {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} until you move or take a hostile action.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature One with the Force|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

Once per turn, when you make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can expend a superiority die and add the number rolled to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Overcapacity Powers|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}

When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-level or higher, you may expend a superiority die to cast the power at a higher level, provided it does not exceed your Maximum Power Level. Roll the superiority die, and add it to the level at which you are casting the power. You can choose to cast it at this new power level or lower.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Overwhelming Wit|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

Once per round, when a creature succeeds on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast or your class feature that requires a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can expend a superiority die to make a universal {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check with proficiency, substituting the result of the roll for the save DC for that power.

optionalfeature.name: Parry
entries: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend one superiority die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your superiority die + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Parry (Improved)
entries: Parry becomes a general {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} for you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Penetrating Shot|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to damage another creature with the same attack. Choose up to two creatures within 15 feet of and directly behind your initial target. If the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} would hit the second creature(s), it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your superiority die.
The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Perform|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Persuade|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: Pilot
entries: When you make an {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Precise Movements|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you or a friendly creature you can see that can see or hear you moves, you can expend a superiority die to give them verbal {@spell Guidance|sw5e-phb|guidance} and encouragement.

Roll a superiority die. The creature's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 5 times the number rolled, and they can move through the space of hostile creatures as if it were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Precision Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} roll against a creature, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the roll. You can use this {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} before or after making the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, but before any effects of the attack are applied.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Program|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Pure Sabacc|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend a superiority die and roll it. On a roll of 4 or higher, you deal maximum damage on the weapon's damage roll, including the superiority die. On a roll of 3 or lower, you instead deal the minimum.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Pushing Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to drive the target back. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, you push the target up to 15 feet away from you.

optionalfeature.name: Rally
entries: On your turn, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and expend one superiority die to bolster the resolve of one of your companions. When you do so, choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you. That creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the superiority die roll + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Rampage|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to expend a superiority die and move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. If you end this movement within 5 feet of a creature, you can make a single {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against that creature, adding the result of the superiority die roll to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Rattle|sw5e-phb}
entries: On your turn, when you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and expend and roll one superiority die to menace your target, dealing extra psychic damage equal to the amount rolled and forcing it to succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} of you until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Reassure|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can expend a superiority die and call out to a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you that is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed}, {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb}, or {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}. When you do so, that creature immediately makes another {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, adding the amount rolled to the save.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Remove Toxins|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can expend a superiority die to purge the toxins from a creature you can touch. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the number rolled and, if it is {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb} or {@condition Diseased|sw5e-phb|diseased}, you neutralize the {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} or disease. If more than one {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} or disease afflicts the target, you neutralize one {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} or disease that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Return Fire|sw5e-phb}
entries: When a creature misses you with a ranged attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend one superiority die to make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against the creature. If you hit, you add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Riposte|sw5e-phb}
entries: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend one superiority die to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against the creature. If the attack hits, you add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Riposte|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: When a creature misses an ally within 30 feet you can see with a melee attack, and that ally can see or hear you, you can expend one superiority die (no action required), and the chosen ally use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against the creature. If the attack hits, the ally adds the superiority die to the attack's damage roll.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Runtime Extension|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}

When a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast with a duration of 1 minute or longer reaches the end of its duration, you may expend a superiority die to extend the duration of the power by a number of rounds equal to the number rolled on your superiority die.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Self-Preservation|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} when you make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against an effect you can see, you can expend a superiority die and add it to the result. You can use this {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} before or after making the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, but before any effects of the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} are determined.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Short Round|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-level or higher that has a casting time of 1 action, you can expend a superiority die to change the casting time to 1 {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} for this casting.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Steady the Nerves|sw5e-phb}
entries: As an action, you can expend one superiority die to strengthen your allies' defenses. Roll a superiority die. Until the end of your next turn, you and all allies within 5 feet of you when you use this action has a bonus to any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} they make equal to the amount rolled.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Strikeforce|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against a creature, you can expend one superiority die and add the number rolled to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. On a hit, the target takes additional force damage equal to the number rolled.

optionalfeature.name: Study
entries: When you make an {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Subtle Execution|sw5e-phb}

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}

When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you may expend a superiority die to cast the power without any visual or auditory cues. Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on any Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) or Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks made to determine if you were the caster.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Sweeping Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to damage another creature with the same attack. Choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your superiority die. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Sweeping Attack|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: When you use the {@optfeature Sweeping Attack|sw5e-phb} {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you add your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier to the damage roll of the second creature.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Targeted Strike|sw5e-phb}
entries: When an ally who can see or hear you makes an attack against a creature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend a superiority die. You add the superiority die to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, and the damage roll if it hits. You can use this {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} before or after the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, but before the GM determines whether or not the attack hits.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Tenacity|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can expend and roll a superiority die and move to an unoccupied space you can see up to a distance equal to 5 x the result of the roll. If you begin this movement hidden from a creature, and you end this movement in a space that could be hidden from the creature, this movement does not reveal your presence to that creature.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Threaten|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Trip Attack|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to knock the target down. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, you knock the target prone.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Tumble|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make an {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb} check, you can expend a superiority die, rolling the die and adding it to the {@dice d20} roll. You can wait until after rolling the {@dice d20} before doing so, but you must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Tyrannical Strike|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend one superiority die and use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to issue a one-word command to a creature who can see or hear you. You add the superiority die to the attack's damage roll, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target must follow the command on its next turn.
The target automatically succeeds if it is immune to charm, it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Unrelenting Grasp|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature within 5 feet of you with an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, you may expend a superiority die. The creature takes additional damage equal to your superiority die, and you may attempt to grapple the target as part of the same {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Vanity|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can expend and roll a superiority die (no action required), regaining a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the result of the roll + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Weak Point Strike|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can expend a superiority die to temporarily daze the creature. Add the number rolled to the damage of the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} and the creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of its next turn.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature World on Fire|sw5e-phb}
entries: On your turn, when you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to expend and roll one superiority die to ignite phosphorescent powder on your target, dealing extra fire damage equal to the result of the roll. Additionally, the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and can't become {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} until the end of your next turn, and becomes visible if it was already {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Wrestle and Drag|sw5e-phb}
entries: When you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check to grapple or shove a creature, you can expend a superiority die. Until the end of your turn, you can drag the {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature with you without your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} being halved. Additionally, if the creature is moved at least 5 feet, you can roll the superiority die, dealing kinetic damage to the creature equal to the result of the roll.

optionalfeature.name: You Call This Archaeology?

entries.name: Prerequisite
entries: The ability to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

When you or a friendly creature that you can see reduces a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a superiority die to give yourself or that friendly creature temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the number rolled + your universal {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} modifier.
